title: Detailed present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boxGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d90429'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boxTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff758f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63946'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribbonV' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f4a261'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribbonH' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f9c74f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e9b949'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowR' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0a500'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63946'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Shadow under present -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='33' ry='5' fill='#3a0ca3' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Box base -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='64' height='34' rx='3' fill='url(#boxGrad)'/>

  <!-- Box base side shading -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='10' height='34' rx='3' fill='#c1121f' opacity='0.35'/>
  <rect x='72' y='52' width='10' height='34' rx='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- Box lid -->
  <rect x='14' y='42' width='72' height='13' rx='3' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <rect x='14' y='42' width='72' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Vertical ribbon on box -->
  <rect x='45' y='52' width='10' height='34' fill='url(#ribbonV)'/>

  <!-- Vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='45' y='42' width='10' height='13' fill='url(#ribbonH)'/>

  <!-- Horizontal ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='14' y='46' width='72' height='7' fill='url(#ribbonH)' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Ribbon cross highlight -->
  <rect x='45' y='46' width='10' height='7' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Ribbon shading -->
  <rect x='45' y='52' width='3' height='34' fill='#e9b949' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='52' y='52' width='3' height='34' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Bow left loop -->
  <path d='M50 42 C38 42 28 32 30 22 C32 12 44 16 50 30 Z' fill='url(#bowL)' stroke='#f0a500' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Bow left loop inner highlight -->
  <path d='M48 40 C40 38 34 30 35 24 C36 18 43 20 48 32 Z' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Bow right loop -->
  <path d='M50 42 C62 42 72 32 70 22 C68 12 56 16 50 30 Z' fill='url(#bowR)' stroke='#e9b949' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Bow right loop inner highlight -->
  <path d='M52 40 C60 38 66 30 65 24 C64 18 57 20 52 32 Z' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Bow center knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#e9b949' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='35' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Bow tails -->
  <path d='M48 44 C44 52 38 60 34 64 C40 62 46 56 49 48 Z' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#e9b949' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M52 44 C56 52 62 60 66 64 C60 62 54 56 51 48 Z' fill='#f0a500' stroke='#e9b949' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Bow tail highlights -->
  <path d='M47 46 C44 52 40 57 37 60 C41 58 45 53 48 47 Z' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle decorations -->
  <g fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.8'>
    <polygon points='25,58 26.5,61 30,61 27.5,63 28.5,66.5 25,64.5 21.5,66.5 22.5,63 20,61 23.5,61'/>
    <polygon points='72,68 73,70 75,70 73.5,71.5 74.5,74 72,72.5 69.5,74 70.5,71.5 69,70 71,70'/>
    <polygon points='65,80 66,82 68,82 66.5,83.5 67.5,86 65,84.5 62.5,86 63.5,83.5 62,82 64,82'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Dots pattern on box for detail -->
  <g fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.35'>
    <circle cx='25' cy='66' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='25' cy='78' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='66' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='72' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='78' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='60' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='60' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
